briefdescription.para: setEngineKind - Controls whether the user wants the interpreter, the JIT, or whichever engine works.
setMCJITMemoryManager - Sets the MCJIT memory manager to use.

detaileddescription.para: This allows clients to customize their memory allocation policies for the MCJIT. This is only appropriate for the MCJIT; setting this and configuring the builder to create anything other than MCJIT will cause a runtime error. If create() is called and is successful, the created engine takes ownership of the memory manager. This option defaults to NULL.

briefdescription.para: setErrorStr - Set the error string to write to on error.
setOptLevel - Set the optimization level for the JIT.
setTargetOptions - Set the target options that the ExecutionEngine target is using.
setRelocationModel - Set the relocation model that the ExecutionEngine target is using.
setCodeModel - Set the CodeModel that the ExecutionEngine target data is using.
setMArch - Override the architecture set by the Module's triple.
setMCPU - Target a specific cpu type.
setVerifyModules - Set whether the JIT implementation should verify IR modules during compilation.

briefdescription.para: selectTarget - Pick a target either via -march or by guessing the native arch.
